reviews.t: Great brush set
reviews.x: Great brush set.  I have long thick hair and it went through it with no issues.  My hair felt very soft and smooth after I brushed it.  I also used it while blow drying my hair and it worked very nicely to straighten it.  The smaller brush is the perfect size to keep in your bag or the car and the mirror was comfortable to hold.  Overall this is a really nice quality gift set.  I did receive this free to review but definitely would consider purchasing another one for a gift for someone else.

reviews.t: I have fine fly away hair and even with my fine
reviews.x: The bristles are very short.  I have fine fly away hair and even with my fine, not so abundant hair, the bristles didn't seem long enough to get through my hair and really brush it.  Also didn't notice any difference about the anti-static effect compared to plastic as claimed.  Oh well, whoever invents the actual thing that cures winter hair will be a millionaire overnight, but these brushes aren't the thing. But if the bristles were longer I like the idea of wood instead of plastic.

reviews.t: Wonderful!
reviews.x: I really love this brush. The wood on it is smooth, and I love the little 'Earth Daughter" emblems. The packaging it came in was wonderful, I felt like I was opening a little present :) brushing my hair with it is amazing, it's not as rough on my scalp like rubber/plastic brushes, and it's soft going through my hair too. It also doesn't pull as much hair out, or hold as much hair in between the little bristles. Definitely something I'll hold onto for a long time.

reviews.t: Great brush!
reviews.x: I really enjoyed this brush.  It is made from very nice material and works great.  I have long curly hair and my daughter has no wavy hair and we are always trying to find a good brush that will last.  Our hair is very think and this brush worked great in both types of hair.  It detangles quickly and feels smooth.  The brush is durable and made from great bamboo.  The small travel brush is perfect for carrying in your purse.  I really liked these brushes.

reviews.t: Switching from AVEDA
reviews.x: Love it so far. I've been using AVEDA brushes for 15 years and normally only replace my brush to buy a new AVEDA one. However in this case I wanted to try this brush and I was offered a small discount to buy it. It comes with a small mirror and a small version of the brush too. It works very well with my hair which is super straight as well as my daughter who is African-American and has different hair texture. Overall I definitely recommend this.

reviews.t: Loved the brush while it worked for my beard
reviews.x: After a few months of use the rubber backing that holds the bristles started to swell causing the bristles to interlace.  The rubber then seemed to melt and the bristles started to fall out.  Loved the brush while it worked for my beard.  The included travel brush is still holding up however that one was not used very often.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the brushes beautiful and well-made, often praising the packaging as gift-ready.
Several reviewers report the brushes pull or rip hair, especially on tangles or thick hair.
Some reviewers experienced durability problems, including cracked or broken wooden pieces and bristle sections detaching.
A few reviewers received a broken mirror in their set.
Multiple reviewers praise the brushes for detangling and working well on curly or tangle-prone hair.
